department: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (OCICS)

deadline.value: International applicants apply by 1 February for Fall entry.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must identify at least one professor willing to supervise your thesis to be eligible.
supervisor.quote: Identify at least one professor who is willing to supervise your research and thesis.

funding.value: Doctoral admits (including international) with an admission average of 8.0/10 (A-) or higher get an admission scholarship of at least CA$72,000 over four years; others rely on supervisor or other funding.
funding.quote: Have an admission average of 8.0/10 or higher. | This financial support offers a minimum value of $72,000 over a period of four (4) years

entry_route.value: Master's in computer science (thesis or equivalent publications) with B+ (75%). Students already in the uOttawa master's can fast-track to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Have a master's degree in Computer Science (with thesis or equivalent in terms of scholarly publications) with a minimum average of B+ (75%).
